Excel is input only.","CP-OS":"Orchestrates selected analysis, current handoffs, bounded retries/cost, resume and verified delivery.","CP-2D":"Builds the near-term liquidity bridge and cash runway.","CP-3D":"Assesses market-implied credit risk and trading technicals.","CP-3C":"Assesses refinancing and liability-management risk before or during distress."},"sources":{"sp-retry.json":"8e746baf3a094dad96bff7c2e2f5abfe47c14abeb9dde1f6324ccf57a84627a8","fitch-and-metrics.json":"4592f83291ccd5545acb18fe6115158532940c7b63697d794cf2cc254385b0e9","fitch-terms.json":"7e14a66c2fd2a4f06eb22ee45e87a8b4a75cb21360399ddb35f26989607d95bf","selected-method":"acf25aaea52bee5da74069fdfe3013c511b4cb2f3e1cb9d3c99fc950a27a62bb","method-steps":"375615b8f373b15461233bb65e47a0f14c8ca34472cd84449d65dba4112c6b3e","historical-case-instructions":"b0a5fab7fee3b08a69e98c9adf76d4c9a48b011d7208b92aa2fdde2477863983","checked-inputs":"37ba9dd109badfd7c212a40f89abf581c22aa3a12e636c50eb4dd94583e430a9"},"handoffs":{"CP-0":{"sha256":"0d42302b9cba18c381d8374db26e0350388dfa00b26d048122fdde8b801b1a79","markdown":"# CP-0 — historical Ford Otosan ratings-case intake

## Request

Admit a separate, explicitly outdated functional case for Ford Otomotiv Sanayi
A.S. (Ford Otosan), April 11, 2024. Current host-model source reading; no provider
or legacy runtime. It does not update TDG or establish current 2026 conditions.

## Sources

S&P: issuer-hosted `documents/Documents/Diger_Duyurular/sp-rating.pdf`, dated
2024-04-11; captured in `sources/sp-retry.json` and `fitch-and-metrics.json`.
Fitch: issuer-hosted `fitch-publishes-ford-otosans-bb-idr-outlook-stable-rates-proposed-eurobond-bbexp.pdf`,
same date; body/terms captured across those two files. The original agency URLs,
report titles and page/line locators are present in the captures. An initial S&P
request failed, then the same source returned readable text. No failed response
is used as evidence. A PDF screenshot attempt timed out; no visual audit claimed.

## Findings

Both identify the same legal company, distinct from its joint-venture parent.
S&P's issuer/issue ratings are preliminary; Fitch publishes an issuer rating and
an expected unsecured issue rating. Source financial summary: calendar 2023
actual and 2024/2025 forecast columns, TRY millions; dollar bond and euro facility
amounts are separate currencies. The historical source contains no later final
issue state. The receiving modules must retain each agency's adjustments and
conditions rather than treat similarly named ratios as interchangeable.

## Calculations

None. This is evidence admission and date/entity/definition scoping.

## Gaps

Retained web-tool text is not original PDF bytes or complete visual validation.
Independent issuer-account extraction, full criteria reconstruction, subsequent
actions/outcomes and current access are outside this intake. Financial forecasts
are agency opinions, not achieved results. This is not full CP-0 pack certification.

## Next module

CP-1: retain the selected agency financial/forecast rows with exact column labels
and inspect the specified rows before calculations. CP-2G then admits the source
forecast; CP-2H owns agency applicability and triggers. Keep this case separate
from all TDG handoffs. Actual deliverables replace CP-MEMO.
"},"CP-1-selected":{"sha256":"a9779359848e8e6c7fed50d4d01cb0c56e60b76b61643c4b00eedd6e429180af","markdown":"# CP-1 — selected historical agency financial input

## Request

Admit financial operands for Ford Otomotiv Sanayi A.S., using the April 11, 2024
S&P report. Historical functional case, explicitly outdated; separate from TDG.
This host-model extraction covers selected agency-reported rows, not full issuer
accounts, full CP-1 or an isolated provider/runtime run.

## Sources

Actual CP-0 source admission and the retained S&P body in
`sources/fitch-and-metrics.json`, PDF page 7, forecast summary. Source columns
2023a/2024f/2025f, text lines 260–262; amounts TRY millions. Exact row locators,
capture hashes, source literals and calculations are in `financial-calculations.json`.
S&P adjusts all figures unless explicitly labelled reported.

## Findings

| Metric | 2023 actual | 2024 agency forecast | 2025 agency forecast |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Revenue | 411,906 | 742,742 | 1,056,981 |
| Reported EBITDA | 50,082 | 64,619 | 82,445 |
| Capitalised development adjustment, signed | (1,932) | (7,249) | (10,393) |
| Disposal adjustment | 65 | -- | -- |
| S&P adjusted EBITDA | 48,214 | 57,370 | 72,052 |
| Cash interest, signed | (4,505) | (8,310) | (11,596) |
| Cash tax, signed | (1,704) | (343) | (5,220) |
| FFO | 42,005 | 48,717 | 55,236 |
| Capex | 30,128 | 38,989 | 52,010 |
| FOCF | 16,425 | 8,611 | 8,834 |
| Dividends | 18,424 | 27,087 | 30,378 |
| DCF | (1,999) | (18,475) | (21,544) |
| S&P adjusted debt | 76,904 | 127,142 | 144,661 |
| Source debt/EBITDA | 1.6x | 2.2x | 2.0x |
| Source FFO/debt | 54.6% | 38.3% | 38.2% |
| Source EBITDA margin | 11.7% | 7.7% | 6.8% |
| Source EBITDA interest coverage | 8.2x | 6.7x | 6.1x |

Reported and adjusted earnings are different. Debt/FFO/margin ratios recomputed
from displayed source amounts round to the reported one-decimal values. EBITDA
interest coverage is not recomputed from cash interest: that would substitute a
different denominator. All currency amounts retain TRY-million units.

## Calculations

The unchanged Decimal quotient helper and independent Fractions check nine
ratios, nine displayed roundings and three FFO identities: 21 checks. The source
display leaves residual −1 in the 2023 known-numeric EBITDA adjustment subtotal
and +1 in the 2024 FOCF-minus-dividend-to-DCF comparison, TRY millions. Preserve
both source figures and residuals. Their cause has not been conclusively resolved;
no zero plug or source correction is made. Source `--` remains null; a subtotal
of identified numeric entries does not establish a missing adjustment as zero.

## Gaps

No independent issuer-account reconstruction or complete S&P adjustment audit.
Original PDF bytes and successful visual cell audit are absent; exact retrieved
text/locators survive. The two displayed residuals remain explicit. Forecasts
are attributed historical opinions, not realised outcomes or current guidance.

## Next module

CP-2G should actually consume these adjusted values and source ratios as a
published case, keeping financial definitions and residuals. CP-2H must not apply
Fitch's net leverage threshold to S&P's adjusted gross debt ratio. This selected
input is usable within scope; it is not full CP-1 acceptance or final delivery.
"},"CP-2G-published":{"sha256":"87fb2d2ac4f8941e8acf51facf2aa2d78fd938d808d6d5e5ea584cd9e3e3b931","markdown":"# CP-2G — published historical forecast admission

## Request

Pass the actual S&P published case for Ford Otosan into CP-2H. Outdated as-of
2024-04-11, independent of TDG. Current host-model consumption; this does not
claim a new management/base/downside engine, a third forecast year or full
CP-2G runtime acceptance.

## Sources

Actually consumed `CP-1-selected-input.md`, SHA-256
`a9779359848e8e6c7fed50d4d01cb0c56e60b76b61643c4b00eedd6e429180af`,
and `financial-calculations.json`; opened the underlying selected S&P summary
rows. The source record is an agency forecast dated April 11, 2024, PDF page 7,
TRY millions except ratios. No TDG number or output is imported into this case.

## Findings

| Calendar year / status | S&P debt | S&P EBITDA | S&P FFO | Recomputed debt/EBITDA | Recomputed FFO/debt |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2023 actual in agency report | 76,904 | 48,214 | 42,005 | 1.5951x | 54.6200% |
| 2024 agency forecast | 127,142 | 57,370 | 48,717 | 2.2162x | 38.3170% |
| 2025 agency forecast | 144,661 | 72,052 | 55,236 | 2.0077x | 38.1831% |

These are recomputations of displayed agency amounts; the source's rounded
ratios remain 1.6x/2.2x/2.0x and 54.6%/38.3%/38.2%. They are not new forecasts.
The published path increases adjusted debt faster than earnings initially,
then improves the leverage ratio as earnings grow. It does not show actual
debt repayment: forecast debt rises in both years. Neither ratio direction nor
an adequate-liquidity opinion proves current financing execution.

Definitions remain agency-specific. S&P's narrative debt includes deferred
consideration/pension adjustments and does not deduct available cash. Its
reported EBITDA interest-cover metric is different from EBITDA/cash-interest.
Fitch's net-leverage/FCF definitions cannot be obtained by substituting these
gross-debt/FOCF ratios. Exact adjustment reconciliation remains incomplete.

## Calculations

The retained financial record independently verifies all three leverage and
FFO/debt recomputations and source-rounded comparisons. The −1 / +1 TRY-million
display residuals stay attached. No source amount was changed or later-year
value fabricated, and no rough narrative FX/year label was used as a new driver.

## Gaps

No independent downside/upside numerical forecast or actual realised outcome.
The agency report is the forecast source, not an independently built CP-2G
model. Full issuer financial reconstruction, Fitch adjustment bridge, raw-PDF/
visual verification and the two source-display residuals remain open.

## Next module

CP-2H: actually consume this published case and both agency reports; identify
which conditions can be assessed and which metrics cannot be compared. Do not
apply Fitch's 2x net-leverage sensitivity to S&P's 2.2162x gross ratio. Preserve
the outdated case and provisional issue status in the next handoff and delivery.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: List pinned issuer sources, hashes and page counts.

tools.name: read_pages
tools.description: Read up to eight pages, numbered from one. Cite the source and page.

tools.name: search_source
tools.description: Find up to twenty matching source excerpts with page locators.

tools.name: calculate
tools.description: Use the existing Decimal-38 kernel. Sum signed operands, or divide two operands. Values are decimal strings or null for missing; ratios are fractions, not percentages. A ratio requires a strictly positive denominator; otherwise it returns null with a reason. Keep period, currency, quantity and source references in your calculation trace.

tools.name: write_handoff
tools.description: Submit the complete Markdown handoff for evidence/instruction checks.

tools.name: edit_handoff
tools.description: Repair a rejected draft with atomic, unique exact-text replacements.

tools.name: score_governance
tools.description: Apply existing row checks and the governance rubric to evidence-based rows. Topics leave behaviour_type, amount_funding_source and legal_capacity_link null; Extraction-Oriented is only a behaviour_flag direction. Flags require those three fields. Tool scoring does not certify the supplied evidence.
